From Luc Besson, director of THE 5th ELEMENT, THE BIG BLUE, NIKITA and DOGMAN (2024), comes the restored classic Director's Cut with an extra 24 minutes added! 

Mathilda, a 12-year-old girl, is reluctantly taken in by Léon, a professional assassin, after her family is murdered. An unusual relationship forms as she becomes his protégée and learns the assassin's trade.


Visually stylish and graphically violent, this intensely emotional film contains career defining performances and stands up as one of the top action-thrillers of all time whilst offering great depth and substance to the tragic multi-layered heroes.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson's life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

movies.title: Incendies
movies.summary:
From Denis Villeneuve, the director of DUNE (Part 1 & 2), PRISONERS, BLADE RUNNER 2049, ENEMY and ARRIVAL  comes the 2010 Academy Award Nominee for 'BEST FOREIGN LANGUAGE FILM", listed on IMDB's TOP 250 BEST RATED FILMS OF ALL TIME based on Lebanese play-writer Wajdi Mouawad's award winning play. 


Nawal (Lubna Azabal), a dying Middle Eastern woman in Montreal, leaves letters for her twin children to be read after her death. Jeanne must deliver her letter to their unknown father, while Simon's letter reveals the existence of a brother they never knew. As the siblings journey to the Levant separately, they encounter acts of brutality and uncover a shocking family history that profoundly impacts their lives.
movies.rights: © 2020 Front Row Filmed Entertainment
movies.plot: Australia, California, Siberia, Sweden, Portugal, Greece, Amazonia...: for more than a decade, the litany of "megafires" has been in the news, so frequently now that one catastrophe chases the previous one in people's minds. Many have forgotten that in 2016, in the oil-rich city of Fort McMurray (Canada), uncontrollable forest fires reached the city, causing the evacuation of almost all of the 100,000 inhabitants and the destruction of thousands of homes. Each year, these fires destroy more than 350 million hectares of forest, six times the size of France, and are increasingly spreading to inhabited areas. In this global investigation, Cosima Dannoritzer meets firefighters, scientists and fire experts from Europe to Indonesia, including the United States and Canada.

movies.title: Endings, Beginnings
movies.summary:
From the producers of SNOWPIERCER and THE HOST and the director of NEWNESS comes a film where "Shailene Woodley, Jamie Dornan, and Sebastian Stan enliven and enrich this film of three 30-somethings caught up in a love triangle..." (Deadline Hollywood).


In present day Los Angeles, Daphne (Shailene Woodley), a thirty something woman, navigates love and heartbreak over the course of one year. Daphne becomes intertwined with friends Jack (Jamie Dornan) and Frank (Sebastian Stan) after meeting them at a party. During that time, she will unlock the secrets to her life in a sudden turn of events and in the most surprising of places.

Along the way, Moana discovers the one thing she’s always sought: her own identity.

The houses in Yonder are identical, suburban homes the place is silent, empty and otherworldly.

After deciding to take his family to a tourist town for some fun in the sun, a minor encounter with local bullies yanks the family into the crosshairs of an unhinged, blood-thirsty crime boss who is determined to derail his relaxation.

Working class Ben Richards (Glen Powell) is coerced into the competition by the show's ruthless producer (Josh Brolin). Ben’s defiance, instincts, and grit turn him into a fan favorite—and a threat to the entire system.

movies.title: Pride & Prejudice

When Elizabeth Bennett (Knightley) meets the handsome Mr. Darcy (Matthew MacFadyen), she believes he is the last man on earth she could ever marry. But as their lives become intertwined in an unexpected adventure, she finds herself captivated by the very person she swore to loathe for all eternity. Based on the beloved masterpiece by Jane Austen, it is the classic tale of love and misunderstanding that sparkles with romance, wit and emotional force. Critics are calling it "Exhilarating. A joy from start to finish" (Carina Chocano, Los Angeles Times).

movies.title: The Dog Stars
movies.summary: Ridley Scott’s “The Dog Stars” is a riveting, epic thriller set in a world where survival is instinct, but humanity is a choice. Scott tells the story of Hig (Jacob Elordi), a young pilot who, together with a military survivalist, Bangley (Josh Brolin), has carved out an efficient but isolated homestead in a brutal post-apocalyptic world. When a mysterious radio transmission reaches Hig, it spurs him to venture into the unknown in search of the hope and humanity he still believes exists. Based on Peter Heller’s captivating bestseller, “The Dog Stars” features a critically acclaimed ensemble, including Margaret Qualley and Guy Pearce. The film is written by Mark L. Smith and directed by Ridley Scott. Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

Broderick and Elwes are the idealistic young Bostonians who lead the regiment; Freeman is the inspirational sergeant who unites the troops; and Denzel Washington, in an Oscar® - winning performance (1989, Best Supporting Actor), is the runaway slave who embodies the indomitable spirit of the 54th Regiment of Massachusetts.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.summary: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn't just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.
movies.plot: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

movies.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory

Thanks to his Grandpa Joe, Charlie gets the prize of his dreams! But a far more wonderful surprise than Charlie ever imagined awaits him. In a land of chocolate waterfalls, giant lollipops, edible flowers and, of course, Oompa Loompas, it's nonstop, mouth-watering fun in the timeless fantasy Charlie And The Chocolate Factory.Based on the children's classic by Roald Dahl.

movies.title: Karate Kid: Legends

But his newfound peace is short-lived after he attracts unwanted attention from a formidable local karate champion. They are enslaved in a Texas brothel and are promised freedom at an incredible cost. The girls must band together and attempt a heart-stopping escape to reclaim their freedom. movies.title: Ratatouille
movies.summary: From Academy Award®-winning director Brad Bird (The Incredibles) and the amazing storytellers at Pixar Animation Studios comes Ratatouille, the original comedy about one of the most unlikely friendships imaginable. The film's protagonist is a rat named Remy (Patton Oswalt) who dares to dream the impossible dream of becoming a gourmet chef in a five-star French restaurant. Undeterred by the obvious problem of trying to make it in the world's most rodent-phobic profession, not to mention his family's urgings to be satisfied with the usual trash-heap lifestyle, Remy's fantasies are filled with flambés and sautés. When circumstances literally drop Remy into the Parisian restaurant made famous by his culinary hero, Auguste Gusteau (Brad Garrett), Remy finds the one thing he needs, a friend to believe in him: the restaurant's shy, outcast garbage boy named Linguini (Lou Romano). Remy and Linguini form the most improbable partnership that will turn Paris upside down, leading them both on an incredible journey of comical twists, emotional turns and the most unlikely of triumphs, which they could never have imagined without each other. Ratatouille brings to life a wide-ranging roster of memorable characters with a voice cast that includes Patton Oswalt, Brian Dennehy, Brad Garrett, Janeane Garofalo, Ian Holm and Peter O'Toole.
